info.name: Sahai Production Backend
info.description:
Complete API reference for the Sahai Production Backend.

**Auth:**
  All customer requests require: Authorization: Bearer {{apiKey}}
  Admin requests require: Authorization: Bearer {{adminKey}}

**Variable chain (auto-saved where noted):**
  Login → apiKey
  Aadhaar Request OTP → txnId
  Aadhaar Verify OTP → txnId, xToken, abhaAddress
  Mobile Request OTP → txnId
  PHR Send OTP → txnId
  PHR Verify OTP → phrToken
  Request Link Token → trackingId, requestId
  Link OTP Init → transactionId
  Request Consent → trackingId, consentRequestId
  Request Health Information → trackingId
  linkToken and consentId arrive at your webhook as raw ABDM bodies — parse and paste manually

**hospitalId is derived from your API key** — never pass it in requests. hipId (linking) and hiuId (consent/health-info) are per-request fields; when hiuId is omitted, the HIU ID registered with your API key is used.
**ABDM tokens are managed automatically** — no manual token handling required.

item.name: 00 - Credentials & Webhook
item.description: Health check, login, API key management, and webhook setup.

request.description: Verify the API is reachable. No auth required.
Verify credentials. Does not issue or rotate the API key — use the key issued at registration for all requests.
Returns hospital profile: hospitalId, hipId, hiuId, webhookUrl, dataPushUrl, environment.
Issue a new API key. Current key is immediately revoked. New key auto-saved.

Register the HTTPS endpoint where Sahai will POST raw ABDM callbacks.

Every request includes:
  X-Abdm-Path: the ABDM callback path (e.g. /v0.5/hip/link/on-add-contexts)
  X-Abdm-Signature: HMAC-SHA256(webhookSecret, rawBody)

The body is the raw ABDM JSON exactly as received — no envelope added.
Verify X-Abdm-Signature before processing.
Send a TEST event to your configured webhook URL. Returns the HTTP status your server returned.

Create a new hospital account. Generates an API key and registers the ABDM bridge. Raw API key is returned once — save it.

webhookUrl/webhookSecret/dataPushUrl are optional here and can be set later via PUT /v1/webhook-endpoint and PUT /v1/data-push-endpoint.
Update the ABDM gateway callback URL for this bridge. Run once per environment.
Register or update HIP/HIU services in the ABDM facility registry. hrp is the list of HRP service objects registered under this bridge.
List all services registered under this bridge with the ABDM gateway.
Diagnostic: attempt a live ABDM gateway token fetch and return full detail. If successful, the token is cached immediately.
Manually inject an ABDM gateway token. Use when auto-fetch is blocked (e.g., sandbox WAF issue).

item.name: 05 - Care Context Linking
item.description:
HIP-initiated and user-initiated care context linking.

HIP-initiated flow: Request Link Token → (wait for webhook linkToken) → Link Care Contexts → Notify Care Context Linked
User-initiated flow: Fetch Auth Modes → Link OTP Init → Link OTP Confirm → (webhook delivers linkToken) → Link Care Contexts

exec: if (j.trackingId) { pm.collectionVariables.set('trackingId', j.trackingId); console.log('trackingId saved:', j.trackingId); }

Poll for async operation result. Works for link-token, consent, and health-information requests.
Fetch available auth modes (MOBILE_OTP, AADHAAR_OTP) for this patient at this HIP.
Initiate OTP auth for user-initiated linking. ABDM sends OTP to patient's mobile. transactionId auto-saved.
Confirm the patient's OTP. On success ABDM delivers a linkToken to your webhook.

item.name: 06 - Consent & Health Information
item.description:
HIU-side consent lifecycle and health information retrieval (Milestone 3).

Flow: Request Consent → consent.granted/denied webhook arrives (notification.status + notification.consentArtefacts[]) → for EACH artefact: Fetch Consent Artefact + Request Health Information → data arrives at your registered data-push endpoint (decrypt via POST /v1/health-information/decrypt) or at Sahai (fetch via /v1/health-records/{{trackingId}}/decrypt).

Consent state changes (GRANTED/DENIED/REVOKED/EXPIRED) are pushed to your webhook URL and also stored — poll GET /v1/status/{{trackingId}}.

request.description:
Request patient consent. Patient acts on the ABDM app. trackingId and consentRequestId auto-saved.

patientReference — required hospital-side patient identifier; used in consent webhooks and decrypt responses to map ABDM data back to the correct patient record.

hiuId — HIU ID for this request. Optional: falls back to the HIU ID registered with your API key when omitted.

requester — identity of the clinician/system initiating this specific request (name + identifier type/value/system). Required per request; set the requesterName/Type/Value/System variables or edit inline.

purpose.refUri — must not be empty; ABDM rejects it (ABDM-9999 Invalid consent purpose refURI). www.abdm.gov.in is the standard value.

If dispatch to ABDM fails, GET /v1/status/{{trackingId}} shows dispatchFailed with ABDM's exact rejection under details.upstream.
Poll until consent status = GRANTED or DENIED.
Direct ABDM query for consent status — use when you need it immediately without waiting for a webhook.

Fetch full consent artefact. consentId comes from the consent.granted webhook — paste into {{consentId}}.

IMPORTANT: a granted consent can carry MULTIPLE artefacts (notification.consentArtefacts[] — typically one per HIP). Loop this call and Request Health Information once per artefact ID to collect the patient's complete data.

Register the HTTPS endpoint where the HIP pushes encrypted health information directly to your system.

Once set, Request Health Information uses this URL automatically (no dataPushUrl needed in the body) and the encrypted FHIR payload is delivered straight to you — Sahai never stores it.

Decrypt the received payload with POST /v1/health-information/decrypt — the ECDH keys stay at Sahai.

If you never set this, data is pushed to Sahai's own /data endpoint, decrypted there, and fetched via GET /v1/health-records/{{trackingId}}/decrypt.

exec: if (j.trackingId) { pm.collectionVariables.set('trackingId', j.trackingId); console.log('trackingId saved:', j.trackingId); }

request.description:
Initiate health data pull from HIP. trackingId auto-saved.

ECDH key material is generated by Sahai automatically — do not pass keyMaterial.

Where the HIP pushes the encrypted data (resolved in this order):
1. dataPushUrl in this body (optional override)
2. Your registered data-push endpoint (PUT /v1/data-push-endpoint) — data goes straight to you, Sahai never stores it; decrypt via POST /v1/health-information/decrypt
3. Sahai's own /data endpoint — Sahai decrypts and stores; fetch via GET /v1/health-records/{{trackingId}}/decrypt

Decrypt an encrypted data push you received directly at your registered data-push endpoint.

Forward the HIP's push payload unchanged: transactionId (or consentId), entries, and keyMaterial exactly as received. Sahai looks up the matching ECDH key session (scoped to your hospital), decrypts, and returns the FHIR bundles in the response.

Keys never leave Sahai; decrypted data is not stored by Sahai. Every call is written to the access-audit trail.

Note: key sessions expire with the request log (30 days). Decrypt promptly after receiving a push.

Check whether health data has arrived for a health-information request.

Statuses: pending (not arrived), dispatchFailed (ABDM call failed — details included), encryptedStored (arrived, nothing decrypted), decrypted (record summaries in result.records).

404 = unknown trackingId for this hospital. Applies to the Sahai data-push path — with a registered data-push endpoint the data goes directly to you instead.

Fetch the decrypted FHIR bundles for a health-information request (Sahai data-push path).

404 with a clear message = data not arrived yet or unknown trackingId. 424 DATA_DECRYPTION_FAILED = data arrived but could not be decrypted (per-entry errors included). Entries whose stored content fails to load carry an error field (readErrorCount > 0).

Every successful call is written to the access-audit trail.

item.name: 07 - HIP Responses
item.description: HIP-side acknowledgements sent back to ABDM. Sahai handles most of these automatically — use only for explicit control.

request.description: HIP sends acknowledgement to ABDM after receiving a consent notification.
HIP acknowledges a health-information request. Sahai handles this automatically — use only for explicit control.
HIP acknowledges a scan-and-share patient profile share. Optionally return a token number to the patient via the ABDM app.

item.name: 08 - Webhook Event Reference
item.description: Reference for raw ABDM callbacks Sahai forwards to your endpoint. Documentation only.

request.description:
Sahai forwards raw ABDM callback bodies to your webhookUrl with no envelope or transformation.

Headers on every request:
  X-Abdm-Path: <abdm-callback-path>   (e.g. /v0.5/hip/link/on-add-contexts)
  X-Abdm-Signature: HMAC-SHA256(webhookSecret, rawBody)
  Content-Type: application/json

Verify: HMAC-SHA256(webhookSecret, rawBody) == X-Abdm-Signature

--- Link Token (HIP-initiated linking) ---
X-Abdm-Path: /v0.5/users/auth/on-fetch-modes  (auth mode fetch)
X-Abdm-Path: /v0.5/users/auth/on-init          (OTP sent)
X-Abdm-Path: /v0.5/users/auth/on-confirm       (linkToken delivered)
body.auth.accessToken → this is the linkToken, paste as {{linkToken}}

--- User-initiated linking ---
X-Abdm-Path: /v0.5/hip/link/carecontext/on-discover
X-Abdm-Path: /v0.5/hip/link/on-init
X-Abdm-Path: /v0.5/hip/link/on-confirm         (linkToken in body.acknowledgement)

--- Consent ---
X-Abdm-Path: /v0.5/consent/hiu/notify
body.notification.status = GRANTED | DENIED | REVOKED | EXPIRED
body.notification.consentArtefacts[0].id → paste as {{consentId}}

--- Health Information (HIP-side) ---
X-Abdm-Path: /v0.5/health-information/hip/request
body.hiRequest.dataPushUrl → where you must push encrypted FHIR data
body.hiRequest.keyMaterial  → HIU public key to encrypt data with
body.hiRequest.consent.id   → consentId
body.transactionId          → use in your on-request acknowledgement

--- Scan & Share ---
X-Abdm-Path: /v0.5/hip/patient/share/profile
body.profile → patient demographics shared from ABDM app
